services.name: whale watching
services.desc: Nestled in the serene waters of the Pacific Northwest, the San Juan Islands offer an unparalleled whale watching experience. This archipelago, located between the U.S. mainland and Vancouver Island, is renowned for its breathtaking landscapes, rich marine life, and, most notably, its world-class whale watching opportunities. Departing from Friday Harbor, the Western Explorer II has a 35 nautical mile range in any direction, ensuring extremely high whale and wildlife sightings throughout the season. services.desc: Join us for an unforgettable private tour from Friday Harbor, on San Juan Island, just 90 miles north of Seattle, Washington. A private charter aboard the Western Explorer II is perfect for: Departure times are available for morning, afternoon, and sunset tours. Typically our group private charters consist of a whale watching and wildlife tour through the San Juan Islands. Bird watching, cruises to outer islands, lighthouses or memorial services are other options. You can book a standard time directly online, or use the info request form for a custom tour. blurb: Guests join a 3-hour whale watching tour on a fast, stable Zodiac or raft-style boat with a full walk-around deck. Tours are guided by experienced naturalists and captains who provide information about whales and local wildlife. The company operates with a conservation focus, donating 5% of profits to environmental organizations.
